So I say only the bare minimum of the truth.

Somehow, somehow I have to steady my breathing and escape.
I have to get out of this school, return to the estate, and tell Akiha I am home―――
“Wh――――what?”
A noise comes from behind me.
“―――It cannot be.”
Has it caught up―――? No, impossible. Something that slow could not overtake me so easily.
